name: Portable Bluetooth speaker
definition: Battery-powered self-contained speaker made to be carried, usually with Bluetooth and often water resistant; a loud party speaker is D3.4.1.10.

name: Party speaker
definition: Large loud self-contained speaker for parties and events, often with lights, handles or wheels and microphone or guitar inputs.

name: Wi-Fi / multi-room speaker
definition: Mains-powered self-contained speaker that streams over home Wi-Fi and groups with others in a multi-room system (Sonos type).
